reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same helper the app uses for posting and previews.

duplication.why: No amount logic is reimplemented; the API field delegates entirely to the shared rule.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler rather than in scheduleModel.toExternal, the tree's API mapping layer, though this keeps the output-only field off the create/update entity type via a separate APIScheduleListEntity.

scope.why: Only the new field, its list type and an API-level test.

maintainability.why: Simple and typed; a second list endpoint would have to remember to add the field since it is not part of the model mapper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getScheduledAmount and still maps through scheduleModel.toExternal.
